description: This file is a C header file containing declarations and macros for secure system command execution functions, including wrappers around system and popen calls with security checks, as well as related macros and external function declarations.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Wrapper around system() with format checking and security diagnostics.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Wrapper around popen() with direction and format validation.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a FILE pointer opened by v_secure_popen.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Standard system call, marked with warning to replace with v_secure_system.

methods.name: secure_system_call_p
methods.description: External function for secure system call with argument vector.

methods.name: secure_system_call_vp
methods.description: External variadic function for secure system call.
